recipe.visualDefinition: A dramatic studio portrait of a long-haired man in a formal tuxedo sitting in an ornate chair, holding a glowing top hat and a cane. The scene is defined by high-contrast theatrical lighting with deep shadows and a hazy, colorful background gradient.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a vibrant color wash
Glowing prop hat acting as a secondary light source
Large-scale script typography integrated into the upper composition
Deep black foreground merging into atmospheric background smoke

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is seated, medium-full shot, positioned slightly right of center to balance the large text on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glowing white top hat held in the subject's right hand.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large script logo, moves down to the glowing hat, follows the cane to the subject's face, and rests on the background glow.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive deep black negative space in the lower half and far left, emphasizing the subject's silhouette.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Luminous white (hat glow and shirt ruffles)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the glowing props and the dark surroundings; saturated background hues provide depth.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy weight with a distinct double-outline
Ascenders and descenders feature long, sweeping flourishes
Letters are filled with a light purple/lavender gradient
characterSpecificRedesigns: Terminal 'r' extends into a long, underline-style flourish

treatment.outline: thick white outer, thin dark inner

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, heavy script paired with a clean, functional sans-serif for legibility.

avoid: Modern geometric sans for the main logo

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s casual but bold script energy
Necessary to achieve the specific double-outline and flourish integration

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of a man with long hair and a mustache, wearing a black tuxedo with a ruffled white shirt, seated in a dark ornate chair. He holds a glowing white top hat in one hand and a thin cane in the other. The background is a dark room with a hazy blue and magenta light wash behind him. The floor is dark and obscured by shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold, lavender-filled script logo in the top left corner, tilted upwards at 15 degrees, featuring a thick white double-outline. Place a small, white, condensed sans-serif subtitle centered below the logo.

verificationChecks: Is the top hat visibly glowing?
Does the script have a double-line outline?
Is the background a mix of blue and magenta haze?
Is the subject's lower body mostly lost in shadow?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Any brand-specific logos in the corners
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the cane is visible against the dark clothing
Verify the script tilt matches the composition's energy
Check that the lavender fill of the text is legible against the background
Confirm the ornate chair legs are visible in the shadows
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a theatrical, high-contrast studio portrait with a glowing prop and a large, double-outlined 70s script logo tilted for dynamic movement.
